description: Use when you need a paid API or MCP server for a task, or a working alternative after a call failed. Pass query in plain words (e.g. weather forecast, web search, image generation); optional protocol (x402 or mcp), only_alive (default true) and limit (1-25, default 10). Read-only; free tier 300 searches a day. Returns services ranked by the open Trust Score (/trust), at most 2 per host unless your query names the host: each with status, advice, trust_score, live price and network, pay_to, pay_to_shared_by_hosts (many hosts on one payTo = a platform wallet), host_listings, uptime and an id that check_service and preflight_payment accept.

only_alive.description: return only services that work as listed right now (default true)

protocol.description: filter by protocol: x402 (pay per call) or mcp (remote MCP server); empty means both

query.description: what you need, in plain words (e.g. weather forecast, web search, image generation)

name: find_service
title: Find working agent services
